observations: body L5: «الخوصى» is printed with the final yāʾ without dots.
body L5, L7: the l of «Pol-» (L5) and the o of «solo» (L7) are printed broken, and a faint stroke is printed above the u of «adnumeratur» (L7); not transcribed.

body L24-L25: the quotation of al-Fishtālī: «طيعة» is printed so (for «طبيعة», as the transliteration ṭabī‘at shows), with one tooth and the two dots of yāʾ; «يسمّيه» with the shadda; the initial mīm of «مضطرب» is printed as a solid round blob.

body L33-L34: the Syriac words are printed in a West Syriac (Serto) type: «ܡܬܩܕܐ» is printed so, with the dot of dālath below (for «ܡܬܩܪܐ»); the sign above the hē of «ܗܰܘ» (haw, «illa») is the West Syriac pṯāḥā, a small Greek alpha printed like a four-armed figure (transcribed ܰ); the sign above the nūn of «ܢܳܛܪ» is the zqāpā.
body L34: «text» is printed without a period and with a space before the comma; «ca» is printed so (for «ea»).
notes_right L6: «géuzi» is printed so, with an accent leaning over the e.
notes_right L11: a short horizontal line is printed above the bēth of «ܕܓܒܪܐ»; not transcribed.
source_authority: Controlling master page image. Embedded text is not the authority for a reading.
transcription_convention: Source line breaks, hyphenation, quotation signs and word-level type distinctions retained. L numbers count text-bearing lines.
review_responsibility: Transcribed by Claude from the page images; Greek, Arabic, numbers and signs read on enlarged images. Not reviewed by a person.
